answer:
The founder of psychoanalysis was **Sigmund Freud**. His father was named **Jacob Freud** (also spelled Jakob Freud), and he worked as a **wool merchant** (textile dealer). 

Jacob Freud ran a family business that traded in wool and various other goods. He was a Hasidic Jewish man from Prague who had emigrated to Vienna when Sigmund was born in 1856.
